crossRefs.note: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
“Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept…
Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the…
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
“Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

translations.web: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
translations.bsb: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
translations.kjv: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
translations.asv: Do ye not make distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
